description: "Fairy Tales, Their Origin and Meaning; With Some Account of Dwellers in Fairyland" by John Thackray Bunce is a scholarly exploration of fairy tales, likely written in the late 19th century. The work aims to examine the origins and meanings of fairy tales and provides insights into the common threads of folklore across various cultures.
